keywords: Problem Solving Process 2.Logical Thinking/Decision Making 3.Project-Based Learning 4.Field research 5.Community Collaboration
educationalGoal: Based on the basic skills acquired in the preceding design project courses, including Introduction to Design Project, students in this course will conduct organized project activities in the real world. Students will discover problems, understand the current situation, and determine issues based on hypotheses derived from data science, and propose solutions by utilizing their expertise. Particular emphasis will be placed on field research to deepen understanding of the main theme and to make proposals that are in line with the actual situation.
advice: In this course, students will engage in organized project activities to solve problems of others in the real world. Students will discover a problem, understand the current situation, and make a decision on the issue from a hypothesis based on data science. In doing so, they will not only acquire knowledge and experience they have already acquired, but also obtain new knowledge through field research and make a "decision based on logical thinking" by integrating these findings. Since this is a five-day intensive course, activities will basically proceed in the order of "data analysis, interview analysis, determination of the direction of the issue, analysis of the cause of the problem and determination of the issue, examination of the required specifications for the solution, and determination of a solution plan. In doing so, in addition to the basic skills acquired in project design, the participants will acquire the skills to use new tools with an eye toward Society 5.0, and aim to conduct creative project activities that make the most of their expertise.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge and experience from Introduction to Design Project and other Design Project courses

activityGoals.body: Able to gather information and recognize problems with respect to issues for which the solutions are diverse.
Able to think logically based on data, facts, and truth
Able to explore and creatively find new challenges
Able to be consolidated and used to solve problems with knowledge acquired in university studies
Able to work efficiently in teams to carry out effective project activities

achievementLevels.ideal: 1.Able to analyze various information on the main theme, identify the need for a solution, and establish a project theme. 2.Able to make logical evaluations and make decisions based on data and facts by gathering information. 3.Able to work in teams on organized project activities to solve problems of others in the real world. 4.Able to propose ideas for solving other people's problems in the real world, making use of their expertise.
achievementLevels.standard: 1.Able to find the project theme from the main theme. 2.Able to conduct project activities in teams to solve problems of others in the real world.

lessons.content: **Team Build and Main Theme** Team build, receive an explanation of the main t heme of this project, and investigate the backgr ound of the theme.
**Data Analysis** Based on the actual data, an analysis is conduct ed to identify the issues facing the subject.
**Examination of issues with a view to direction ** Based on the analysis of actual data, the direct ion of any issue will be discussed.
**Interview with the person concerned** Conduct interviews with parties related to the t heme.
**Analysis of interview results** By text mining of the interview results, it's ch ecked to the validity of the directions consider ed.
**Preparation of interim report** Prepare materials to report on the direction in which the team will consider solutions to the hy potheses they have developed.
**Interim Report and Additional Research** It will be reported the direction in which the s olution to the team's hypothesis. The team will also discuss the research plan t o support this direction.
**Discussion and generation of ideas** Based on the policy decided by the team and the results of the survey, discuss ideas and make an implementation plan.
**Prototype of proposed idea 1st** Prototype the proposed idea.
**Prototype of proposed idea 2nd** Prototype the proposed idea.
**Check the implementation status** Test the prototype idea.
**Evaluation test** Operate the prototype idea and collect experimen tal data.
**Preparation for reporting final results** Prepare presentation materials to report the ide as proposed in this project activity.
**Final report** Visit the city hall to present the final report of the proposed ideas.
**Review and self-evaluation** Review and self-evaluation of the project activi ties.
